title: Hay Creek Ranch

services.name: Tent Sites
services.desc: Hay Creek has five tent sites for the true outdoorsy equestrians. You’ll have a spacious spot complete with a mix of shade and sun, fire pit and picnic table. Private bathrooms and showers are nearby in the shower

services.name: RV Sites
services.desc: Plenty of room for your rig, with water and electric hook ups, and dump station access. Private bathrooms and showers are nearby in the shower

services.name: Cabins With all the Extras
services.desc: For the campers who want it all, we have four roomy cabins with your own bath, kitchenette and electric heat. Perfect for staying in the early or late season when it gets refreshingly

services.name: Trail ride
services.desc: Pull up your current location while out on the trail and get the mileage to the next intersection. Mark destinations with pictures or record your hike all without draining your battery. Navigate trails

blurb: Surrounded by the Black Hills National Forest with cabins, RV and tent sites. Bring your horses to ride hundreds of miles of trails with terrain for every experience level and numerous creek crossings. Top-rated local favorite camping destination.
